QUOTE: **Unknown section names are refused.** A misspelled top-level key fails and names the probable cause. Keys with an `x-` prefix are tolerated and ignored. A malformed declaration degrades to defaults.

VERDICT: MISS

WHY: The answer says unknown sections are refused, but it never says the refusal names the allowed set. It also never gives the reason that an ignored section would build with defaults while reporting the declaration was honoured.
